info.name: Grafana Set Resource Permissions For Built In Role

items.docs: This API operation allows administrators to configure and assign specific resource-level permissions to a built-in role within Grafana's access control system. By making a POST request to this endpoint with a specified resource type, resource ID, and built-in role identifier, you can define granular permissions that determine what actions the built-in role can perform on that particular resource.
